title: Pro Tips with Michelle
lyrics:
[Intro]
Pro tips with Michelle
Pro tips with Michelle
Pro tips with Michelle

[Verse 1]
Don't lose focus
Or you might hit the net
Don't look at the ceiling
Or you'll lose the set
Tighten up your grip
Mate
Or your wrist will be upset
It takes more than a couple swings
For your brain to get the swing of things
But that's okay

[Chorus]
A little pickle a day keeps the pickle at bay
A little pickle a day keeps the pickle at bay

[Verse 2]
Your first few games
Are gonna be a bit rough
You might not hit it on the bounce
You might miss the ball altogether
But stick with it
And in a few months
You'll be
Bloody legendary
Mate

[Chorus]
A little pickle a day keeps the pickle at bay
A little pickle a day keeps the pickle at bay
A little pickle a day keeps the pickle at bay
A little pickle a day keeps the pickle at bay

[Outro]
Pro tips with Michelle
Pro tips with Michelle
Pro tips with Michelle
Pro tips with Michelle
